answer: I read both the standard and the operator's patch management procedure. The standard (CIP-007-6 R2) establishes the regulatory requirements, while the operator's procedure (LSPG Security Patch Management Procedure) provides the documented implementation details. The standard sets the framework with requirements like tracking patches every 35 calendar days, evaluating applicability, and implementing mitigation plans, while the operator's procedure describes their specific processes, inventories, evaluation workbooks, and mitigation plan management within that framework. The operator's procedure includes specific sections on application inventories, discovery and evaluation, patch implementation, and mitigation plan management that map to the standard's requirement parts.
